result.title: HandiVid: A High-Quality Dataset for Hand-Driven Interactive Video Generation
result.summary: Hand-driven egocentric interactive video generation aims to generate dynamic scenes with realistic interaction responses conditioned on hand movements and camera motion. However, existing egocentric video datasets struggle to provide scene diversity, meaningful hand-object interactions, and reliable motion annotations simultaneously. To address these limitations, we introduce HandiVid, a high-quality dataset comprising 200K curated and annotated egocentric interaction video clips for hand-driven interactive video generation. We develop a unified data processing pipeline that integrates public datasets, online videos and synthetic videos. Through video quality assessment, hand detection filtering, and multi-stage interaction validation using vision-language models (VLMs), we select high-quality video clips with meaningful hand-object interactions. Since 3D hand reconstruction relies on initial hand detections, we integrate SAM 3 into the hand detection pipeline to reduce missed detections and improve the completeness of 3D hand annotations. Each video clip is provided with high-quality hand renderings, camera trajectories, and interaction descriptions. Comprehensive dataset analysis and downstream video generation experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of HandiVid in terms of data diversity, annotation quality, and controllable video generation.

AI.brief_summary: 构建 20 万条第一视角手部交互视频数据集 HandiVid，配套手部 3D 标注、相机轨迹与交互描述，用于手部驱动的交互式视频生成。
AI.relevance_reason: 属于视频生成数据构建与可控生成，虽用 VLM 做交互筛选，但不涉及多模态推理状态、证据获取或停止决策等主线问题，无可核查的借鉴线索。
